cards.public_summary: Baker Mayfield said the Buccaneers were out-physicaled in practice with Jacksonville and likely would not have won if it were a full game.
cards.evidence:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield says if today’s practice with the Jags was a full game, he doesn’t think they would’ve come out on top. 

He called today “eye-opening” and said he thought they were “out-physicaled,” which you never want. https://t.co/xZhxdogVzj
cards.commentary: Mayfield's comments signal concern about Tampa Bay's practice performance, but they do not establish an injury, role change or actionable change to his fantasy outlook.
